name: Debezium Zero Date Fallback Custom Converter

display.label: Target column types
display.description: Comma-separated list of Oracle column types this converter applies to. Allowed tokens: DATE, TIMESTAMP. Default: DATE,TIMESTAMP

display.label: DATE zero-date fallback
display.description: Replacement value emitted for Oracle DATE zero dates (0000-00-00 00:00:00) and absent values. Use 'NULL' (or leave unset) to emit null and make the column schema optional. Otherwise specify a UTC literal in the form yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

display.label: TIMESTAMP zero-date fallback
display.description: Replacement value emitted for Oracle TIMESTAMP zero dates and absent values. Use 'NULL' (or leave unset) to emit null and make the column schema optional. Otherwise specify a UTC literal in the form yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss[.fffffffff].

display.label: Column selector
display.description: Comma-separated list of regular expressions matched against <database>.<schema>.<table>.<column>. Only matching columns have this converter applied. Default '.*' matches every column whose type is in target.types. Default: .*
